latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.62-cyberdeck

preUpdateBackup.reason: A/B app-only OTA does not write NVS, LittleFS, or SD; manual SD backup remains available as a separate queued action.

latest.notes: Fixes normal startup so the splash always hands off to the launcher, limits the SD restore banner to 15 seconds, and improves launcher contrast. App-only A/B OTA never overwrites MeshCore, NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, or local preferences.
